Players Committee card image of [[Rukh]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “While armed with a blaster, your assassins and leaders here are immune to Blaster Proficiency and Clash Of Sabers and, if Shadow Collective just flipped, may peek at top two cards of your Reserve Deck and take one into hand.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/rukh.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/rukh.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
